## 2026-03-30 - Two-Pointer Interval Overlap for Shift Schedules
**Learning:** Shift occurrences generated by `ShiftScheduleCalculator.Calculate` are inherently generated in chronological order day-by-day. Using an O(N) check for sortedness allowed upgrading the O(N * M) nested-loop overlap check in `HasOverlap` to an O(N + M) two-pointer interval scan with zero heap allocations on the hot path.
**Action:** When working on interval-based domain calculations in this codebase, leverage the chronological ordering guarantees of generated sequences to keep algorithm complexity linear without allocating memory.

## 2026-03-31 - Zero-Allocation Slot Availability Evaluation
**Learning:** Calling LINQ `.Any(b => ...)` inside candidate slot generation loops (e.g. `AvailabilityEngine.GetSlotsAsync`) instantiates display class closures and enumerators for every 30-minute interval on every public request. Hoisting `TimeSpan` calculations outside the loop and replacing LINQ closures with an indexed `for` loop in a helper method eliminates per-iteration heap allocations on the public booking hot path.
**Action:** When computing time slots or iterating over candidate intervals, hoist constant `TimeSpan` instantiations outside the loop and avoid LINQ predicate closures in per-slot evaluations.
